items.title: Robyn Enlists Zara Larsson For “Talk To Me” Remix
items.summary: "Zara woke up big sweden." That was what someone with the Twitter handle @BOTTLEBLONDEZ posted last November, back when Robyn first teased her single "Dopamine." That phrase has been in my head ever since. If it means nothing to you, the idea is that the sudden viral success of the long-toiling Swedish pop star Zara Larsson was enough to stir Robyn from her years-long slumber. I love it.
